transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Nadia. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My phone bill shows a charge of thirty pounds for calls to a number I don't recognise, and it's not the first time. I'm worried someone's using my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's worrying, I'm sorry. Let's look into it. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So there's a thirty-pound charge for calls to a number you don't recognise, and it's happened before. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What's the number on the bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does anyone else use your phone, children perhaps?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a premium-rate competition line. It's very likely your son entered a competition on a game.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: But I didn't think that was possible. Can you block those numbers?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can add a premium-rate bar. I'll do that now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what about the thirty pounds?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We've been over this, I'm not going to keep repeating myself. The calls were made from your phone, so the charge stands.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Well, I'll have to see.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The bar is on. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
